title: Change Assessment
description: Universal output schema for all maintenance checks. Each finding produces one change assessment with risk/complexity scoring.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the finding, its impact, and context.

risk.description: Risk score aligned with bd priority. 0 = critical (breaking production, security vulnerability), 1 = high (end-of-support, significant regression risk), 2 = moderate (compatibility concerns, non-trivial testing), 3 = low (minor version bump, well-tested path), 4 = informational (nice-to-have, no urgency).

complexity.description: Implementation complexity. 0 = trivial (single command or config change), 1 = small (a few file edits, no architectural change), 2 = moderate (multiple components affected, testing required), 3 = large (cross-stack changes, migration steps), 4 = epic-scale (multi-sprint, architectural redesign).

current_state.description: What exists today — version, configuration, or relevant current context.

affected_files.description: Workspace-relative file paths that would need to change.

breaking_changes.description: Whether this change introduces breaking changes to the project or its consumers.

source_urls.description: Reference URLs — release notes, blog posts, advisories, documentation.

auto_actionable.description: Whether this finding can be safely auto-PR'd without human review. True when: risk >= 3, complexity <= 1, no breaking changes.
